method.note: theme-matched across 49 lexicon words (1524 candidates); faces and textInImage rejected; dark/cold readings preferred
method.curation: Kept 8 of 21. Dropped ['glass', 'scream', 'glass', 'hands', 'rage', 'panic', 'press', 'window', 'crack', 'free', 'stage', 'crowd', 'empty']: the lexicon's art for those words is chalk-drawn, rainbow, sunlit or Gothic-warm — it would fight a cold glass-case film. The lexicon has very little dark/institutional/glass imagery; this is a genuine coverage gap, not a curation preference.
